welcome:
Hi! I'm a music bot.

Type a song title, an artist name, or a line from the lyrics — and I'll find the audio for you.

Commands:
/language — change language
/cut — trim audio
/playlist — playlists
/top — leaderboards
/help — help
help:
How to use the bot

• Type a song title, artist, or a fragment of the lyrics — I'll find the music.
• Pick a result from the list or tap "More tracks".
• To trim a track, use /cut and choose one of the songs you recently received.

Playlists:
/playlist — manage playlists
/top — playlist and user leaderboards

Commands:
/start — start
/language — change language
/cut — trim audio
download_error: Could not download the track. Try another one.
file_too_big: File is too big to send (limit {limit} MB).
all_sources_failed: All sources are unavailable. Try again later.
cut_no_recent: You have no received songs yet. Find and get a track first, then use /cut.
cut_ask_times:
Send the start and end time in this format:
00:00:30 00:01:15

(Start and end separated by a space)
cut_done: Done! Here is your trimmed clip.
cut_error: Could not trim the audio. Check your timecodes.
cut_range_error: The end time must be greater than the start time.
generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
lyrics_not_found: Lyrics not found for this song.
more_artist_none: No other songs found for this artist.
